sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 3952 of 2023

Applicant :- Pati Ram
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
Counsel for Applicant :- Aditya Kumar Shukla

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Aditya Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, and Sri Manish Kumar Pandey,
learned Addl. Government Advocate.
2. By means of the instant application the applicant Patiram S/o Kaushal seeks bail in Case Crime No. 363 of 2022, under sections 498A, 306 IPC, P.S. Tikait Nagar, District Barabanki.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a first information report (F.I.R.) lodged on 17.9.2022 against the applicant and 5 of his family members stating that the informant's daughter was married to the applicant about 12 years prior to lodging of the FIR and on 12.9.2022 all the accused persons killed the her and this information was given to the informant by the deceased's son Anuj.
4.
The postmortem report of the dead body of the deceased mentions only injury to be a 'ligature mark' around her neck.

Pati Ram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122768953/
1 5.

entities.text: Pati Ram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The applicant's mother and father have already been granted bail by means of order dated 12th of January 2023 passed by this court in Bail application No. 598 of 2023.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the deceased died 12 years after her marriage and the postmortem report mentions the presence of a ligature mark around her neck and there was no other injury on the body of the deceased; that two of the co-accused persons have already been granted bail and that the applicant has no criminal history and he is languishing in jail since 19.9.2022, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 22.3.2023 A.Nigam  Pati Ram vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/122768953/
